_routeNote: The Wallet API route needs no prover and no discovery/indexer service. The wallet holds the viewing key, discovers notes, generates the proof and submits. The dapp only requests actions. This is why Strongbox does not self-host any privacy infrastructure.
_wallets: MAINNET-DAY-0.md names Ready or Braavos; other STRK20 pages name Ready or Xverse. Ready appears in both, so Ready is the primary target. Verify the others before relying on them.
